¢ Syria would still have been embroiled in a bitter civil war. And Iran — would still be striving for regional hegemony and nuclear military capability.

¢ The reasons for all the above are deeply rooted in the history of the nations and the region — and do not stem from the Israeli Palestinian conflict (they may be related to it in another way, which I will get to later on).

¢ In the new reality forged by the "Arab Spring," there is good news and bad news for us.
